The supplied package shows only scored need text, source_id, and source_weight; it does not show observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes. Under the strict market-demand criteria, that is insufficient to establish customer demand, so the selected need remains unsupported at the producer boundary even though downstream behavior is deterministic.
